verification.subject: Verify your email for {appName}
verification.title: Verify your email
verification.body: Thanks for signing up! Please click the button below to verify your email address.
verification.ignore: If you didn't create an account, you can safely ignore this email.

passwordReset.subject: Reset your password for {appName}
passwordReset.title: Password Reset
passwordReset.body: Click the button below to reset your password
passwordReset.ignore: If you didn't request a password reset, you can safely ignore this email.

otp.subject: Your {appName} verification code
otp.preview: Use this code to continue with {appName}
otp.title: Your verification code
otp.body: Use this one-time code to continue with {appName}.
otp.ignore: If you didn't request this code, you can safely ignore this email.

videoReady.subject: Your {appName} video is ready
videoReady.preview: Your video is ready to watch, download and post.
videoReady.title: Your video is ready
videoReady.body: Your video has finished rendering. Open it to watch it with its music.
videoReady.linkFallback: Or copy this link into your browser:
videoReady.download: On the video page, tap Download MP4. Wait a moment while the music is added, then the MP4 saves to your device.
videoReady.tiktok: On your phone, tap Share on the video page and pick TikTok, or open TikTok, tap + and choose the video you saved. On a computer, tap Share, then TikTok: the video downloads, a caption is copied and the TikTok upload page opens.
videoReady.reply: Not happy with it? Just reply to this email and we'll help.
videoReady.signIn: Opening it on a different device or browser? Sign in with this email address first to see your video.
videoReady.footer: You're receiving this because you made a video with {appName}.
